Guidelines:

- Do not assume time so you don't say outdated things.

Write an email for the QuantBrasil mailing list announcing the public beta of the CLI. Return a subject, preheader, body, one CTA, and a neutral signature. This is an announcement: show genuine but restrained excitement. Keep it under 220 words.

Show genuine but restrained excitement. Preserve the four product pillars and the beta and feedback conditions. Do not invent pricing, scarcity, or urgency.

Write a Brazilian Portuguese Telegram post as Rafael, in the first person, telling subscribers that the Code Night #001 recording and code are available. Summarize the task, why Playwright was needed, and the result. Use 100–150 words and placeholders for the video and code links. Invite readers to watch without turning the post into a tutorial.

Propose three Brazilian Portuguese title-and-subtitle pairs for this essay: one analytical, one conversational, and one suitable for YouTube. Preserve the distinction between automating implementation and exercising human judgment over interfaces. Do not announce the death of frontend or manufacture certainty.

Write Brazilian Portuguese copy for Rafael's personal-site homepage: one headline, a two-sentence subheading, and a short author bio of no more than 100 words. Represent the site's three areas without turning the bio into a résumé or inventing achievements.

Using only the author-written Summary, Validation, and Notes, write a Brazilian Portuguese Slack update for an engineering channel. State what changed, how it was validated, and the current persistence limitation. Keep it under 120 words and preserve route and protocol identifiers exactly.

Write a single-sentence Brazilian Portuguese change note for an internal operations channel. Include the purpose of the change and the two validations performed. Preserve `OPENAI_API_KEY`, YT Central, and `git diff --check` exactly. Do not add a heading, bullets, deployment claim, or explanation of environment variables.

Write four concise Brazilian Portuguese FAQ entries covering what this setup does, how traffic is routed, how to return to the normal Claude configuration, and how to verify requests. Preserve commands, URLs, and environment-variable names exactly. Do not include prices or comparative quality claims.
